title: Ink-sketching a gharial's snout
storyboard: Film: overhead ink-pen journal sketch of a gharial, timelapse, then close-up of labels being written

scenes.headline: Drawing the strangest snout in India
Long, thin snout: built for catching fish.
Adult males grow a knob on the snout tip: the ghara
scenes.body: This one is a female, so the sketch gets no knob.

caption:
One long snout, drawn in ink.

Gharials are almost entirely river animals, so dams, sand mining and fishing nets in their rivers are among the biggest threats to them.

Source: IUCN Red List, Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Storyboard: different species, medium (ink) and angle from variant 1; the reference is a wild female, and the sketch notes say so.
